ItemID: unavailable; Title: E-SDS Deck Joist Tape, Butyl Joist Flashing Tape for Decking, Beams 4" x 50'; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My previous adhesive purchases were for fastening and repair; I do not currently need deck waterproofing tape.
